name: benzyl alcohol + lidocaine
uses: Use For the temporary relief of pain
otcwarn: Do not use on wounds or damaged skin in largge quantities with a heating pad if you are allergic to any ingredients of this product Stop use and ask a doctor if skin reactions occur, such as rash, itching, redness, irritatin, pain, swelling and blistering conditions worsens symptoms persist for more than 7 days symptoms clear up and occur again within a few days
